dīmissōriaelitterae dicuntur, quae vulgo
I.apostoli dicuntur (notice sent to a higher judge): “dimissoriae autem dictae, quod causa ad eum, qui appellatus est, dimittitur,” Dig. 50, 16, 106 ; cf. ib. 49, 6, 1.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
